questions.stem: 這間美術館裡的畫，大多是由台灣畫家畫的。
questions.answer: Most of the paintings in this art museum were painted by Taiwanese artists.
accepted_answers: Most of the pictures in this art museum were painted by artists from Taiwan.
Most paintings in this art museum were created by Taiwanese painters.

questions.stem: 老師講解完這些畫之後，全班在美術館前面拍了很多照片。
questions.answer: After our teacher explained these paintings, the whole class took many photos in front of the museum.
accepted_answers: After our teacher had explained these paintings, the whole class took many pictures in front of the museum.
After the teacher talked about these paintings, our whole class took lots of photos outside the museum.

1.explanation_zh: 「是由…畫的」表示畫是被畫家畫出來的，用被動語態 were painted by …；畫作是過去完成的，用過去式。主詞「大多數的畫」寫 most of the paintings（或 most paintings），是複數，be 動詞用 were；也可以寫 The paintings … were mostly painted by …。畫作是 painting，不是 paint（顏料）；「台灣畫家」寫 Taiwanese artists 或 artists from Taiwan。
1.strategy_zh: 看到「由／被＋人＋動詞」先想被動：被做的東西當主詞，動作者放在 by 後面。
hints: 切成四段：這間美術館裡的畫／大多／由台灣畫家／畫的
標的詞彙：painting（畫作）、art（藝術）、museum（美術館）、most（大多數）、paint（畫）、artist（畫家）
句型框架：Most of the + 複數名詞 + were + p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「老師講解完這些畫之後」有自己的主詞「老師」，和主要子句的主詞「全班」不同，所以要寫成完整的時間副詞子句 After + 主詞 + 動詞：After our teacher explained these paintings, …。不能省略成 After explaining these paintings，因為主要子句的主詞是 the whole class，省略後會變成「全班講解完這些畫」。整件事已經發生，兩個動詞都用過去式（explained、took）；要強調先後也可以寫 had explained。「講解」用 explain 或 talk about；「全班」是 the whole class；「拍照」的搭配是 take photos／take pictures，take 的過去式是 took，「很多照片」要用複數 photos；「在美術館前面」是 in front of the museum。
evidence: 老師講解完這些畫之後
2.strategy_zh: 「A 做完…之後，B 做…」兩個主詞不同時，時間子句一定要寫出自己的主詞：After + A + V, B + V；主詞相同才可以考慮省略成 After + V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：老師講解完這些畫之後／全班／在美術館前面／拍了很多照片
標的詞彙：teacher（老師）、explain（講解）、painting（畫作）、class（班級）、museum（美術館）、take（拍〔照〕）、photo（照片）
句型框架：After + 主詞 A + V（過去式）…, 主詞 B + V（過去式）…

1.translation: Most of the paintings in this art museum were painted by Taiwanese painters.
1.explanation_zh: 「大多是由……畫的」是被動，用 were painted by；畫是過去完成的作品，用過去式被動；「大多」用 Most of the paintings 當主詞，所以動詞用複數 were；「美術館」用 art museum；「台灣畫家」用 Taiwanese painters（也可說 Taiwanese artists，避免 paint 重複出現）。

2.translation: After the teacher finished explaining these paintings, the whole class took many photos in front of the art museum.
2.explanation_zh: 「……之後」用 After 引導的副詞子句放句首，後面加逗號；「講解完」的「完」用 finish + V-ing（finished explaining）；兩件事都已經發生，用過去式 took；「全班」用 the whole class 當單數主詞；「拍了很多照片」用 took many photos（也可 took a lot of pictures）；「在美術館前面」用 in front of the art museum。

issues_zh: 「美術館」另一個常見而且正確的譯法 art gallery（或 gallery）不在第 1 部分「這間美術館裡的畫」的 accepted 裡，也不是標的詞彙 museum 的 alternatives：學生寫 "Most of the paintings in this art gallery were painted by Taiwanese artists." 第 1 部分會被判不符，標的詞彙只命中 5/6。建議第 1 部分補 "the paintings in this art gallery"、"the paintings in this gallery"，museum 的 alternatives 補 gallery。

第 1 部分有 "the pictures in this art museum" 和 "the paintings in this museum"，卻沒有 "the pictures in this museum"；"Most of the pictures in this museum were painted by Taiwanese artists." 第 1 部分被判不符（標的詞彙 art 也會漏），建議補上。

第 1 部分「老師講解完這些畫之後」的 accepted 是把整段子句一個一個列出來，組合不齊：painting 的 alternatives 有 picture，但沒有任何 pictures 的寫法（"After the teacher explained these pictures" 被判不符）；"After our teacher had talked about these paintings"、"When the teacher finished explaining the paintings" 這類合理組合也沒列到。建議改用 answer_segments 式的可替換段，或補齊 the／these、pictures、had talked about、When … the paintings 的組合。
第 3 部分「在美術館前面」沒有 "in front of the gallery"／"in front of the art gallery"，理由同第 1 句（美術館＝art gallery 也正確）。

1.translation: Most of the paintings in this art museum were painted by Taiwanese artists.
1.explanation_zh: 「大多是……」用 most of the + 複數名詞；「由台灣畫家畫的」是被動語態 were painted by；「畫家」用 artists（painters 亦可）。畫已完成，用過去式被動。

2.translation: After the teacher finished explaining the paintings, the whole class took a lot of photos in front of the art museum.
2.explanation_zh: 「講解完……之後」用 After 引導的副詞子句，finished explaining 表示講解完畢；因兩件事都已發生，主要子句用過去式；「全班」用 the whole class；「在美術館前面」用 in front of。
